statBlock.name: Black Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: A swamp-dwelling wyrmling that hunts from the water and exhales a narrow jet of acid.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The wyrmling breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Acid damage.
Acid Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 22 (5d8) Acid damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.

statBlock.name: Blue Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: An electric-blue wyrmling at home in desert and coastal burrows.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Lightning damage.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 21 (6d6) Lightning damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.

statBlock.name: Green Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: A forest wyrmling that can breathe underwater and fill a clearing with poison.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The wyrmling breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.
Poison Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature takes 21 (6d6) Poison damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.

statBlock.name: Red Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: A fire-breathing wyrmling that climbs the hills and mountains where it lives.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 24 (7d6) Fire damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.

statBlock.name: White Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.speed: 30 ft., burrow 15 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 30 ft.
statBlock.description: An arctic wyrmling that moves across ice and hunts with a blast of cold.

sections.Traits: Ice Walk. The wyrmling crosses and climbs icy surfaces without an ability check. Ice and snow never cost it extra movement as Difficult Terrain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature takes 22 (5d8) Cold damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.

statBlock.name: Brass Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: A desert wyrmling that burrows into the sand and breathes either fire or sleep gas.

sections.Actions:
Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 20-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 14 (4d6) Fire damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.
Sleep Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. A second failure leaves it Unconscious for 1 minute. Taking damage ends the effect, as does a creature within 5 ft. taking an action to wake it.

statBlock.name: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: An amphibious coastal wyrmling with lightning breath and a blast that knocks creatures back.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The wyrmling breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 40-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 16 (3d10) Lightning damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.
Repulsion Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 12 Strength save. On a failure, it is pushed up to 30 ft. straight away from the dragon and knocked Prone.

statBlock.name: Copper Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: A hill-dwelling wyrmling that climbs as readily as it walks and can slow pursuers with its breath.

sections.Actions:
Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.
Acid Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 20-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 18 (4d8) Acid damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.
Slowing Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, its Speed is halved, it loses access to Reactions, and it can take at most one action or Bonus Action on its turn. These restrictions end at the end of its next turn.

statBlock.name: Gold Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: An amphibious wyrmling that lives in forests or grasslands. Its two breaths burn or weaken foes.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The wyrmling breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 22 (4d10) Fire damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.
Weakening Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone that is unaffected by this breath makes a DC 13 Strength save. On a failure, it has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 2 (1d4) from its damage rolls. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. After 1 minute the save succeeds automatically.

statBlock.name: Silver Dragon Wyrmling
statBlock.description: A wyrmling found in mountains and cities whose breath can chill or paralyze.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature takes 18 (4d8) Cold damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.
Paralyzing Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. A second failure leaves it Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. After 1 minute the save succeeds automatically.
